dedupe_keys.name: controlled laboratory measurements of dune erosion under variable waves water levels and dune pore moisture

description: Controlled laboratory measurements of dune erosion under variable waves, water levels and dune pore-moisture is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by S. Conti et al. Controlled laboratory wave flume experiments of dune erosion can assist researchers to explore the physical processes of dune erosion and improve numerical predictive models. This paper presents a dataset of controlled laboratory measurements of unvegetated dune erosion under vary waves, water levels, and initial dune moisture contents. Coverage: a single site or case study; published in 2025. Formats: CSV, MATLAB, TXT. The data are held in Zenodo and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
